snapshot.text: Small high-performing system financed through the social security fund (CASS) with co-payments. The government has a sustainability plan for the health system and is trying to attract family doctors.

priorities.title: Recruiting family doctors
priorities.text: Andorra wants to attract family doctors with better pay per consultation and lower taxes.

priorities.title: Health dashboard
priorities.text: A public dashboard with 67 key health indicators was launched in 2026.
